messages.content: Create REST API integration tests for 4thBrain. Test POST /api/ingest/text (small text, 300 chars), /api/ingest/file (text file), /api/ingest/url (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10435). Verify: HTTP 200, jobId, database records, files written. Use node:test, createTestDb/createTestCfg helpers. Create server/test/api-ingestion-integration.test.js with 7+ tests. Report: pass/fail summary, issues found, coverage, recommendations.
